deploy-bot: Deploy started — service=runtime env=prod-us-west tag=release-2.4.0 commit=9a3f6b2 initiator=@maria change_window=22:00-23:00. Rolling to 100% over 10m. Release notes: https://ci/release/2.4.0
maria: starting rollout now, monitoring dashboards (apm + errors)
alex: watching logs, setting alert to page if error rate > 2% :eyes:
sanjay: seeing slow tails on p99 in EU1 (~800ms) but prod-us-west looks okay
deploy-bot: Canary reached 10% (10/100). No immediate errors.
olivia: pulling traces — multiple 502s from runtime/decoder at 22:06:11
maria: hmm, `grep decoder` in pods shows spike in latency across a subset of instances
alex: rolling back if we see error rate > 1.5% for 2 consecutive mins — agree?
maria: agree, manual rollback ready
deploy-bot: Healthcheck failures detected on service=runtime env=prod-us-west threshold=1.6% duration=2m — initiating rollback to tag=release-2.3.4
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by automation (reason=healthcheck failure). Reverting to commit=f3d4b88 tag=release-2.3.4 :rotate_left:
alex: copying runbook link https://wiki/runbooks/runtime-rollback — hit enter when ready
maria: revert deploy started manually to pin release-2.3.4, grabbing logs
deploy-bot: Revert deploy in progress — env=prod-us-west target_tag=release-2.3.4 jobs=4
sanjay: quick check: are we disabling autoscale while revert finishes? we should
maria: yes, disabling autoscale for runtime for now (`kubectl scale --replicas=0 hpa/runtime` temporarily)
deploy-bot: Revert deploy completed — service=runtime env=prod-us-west tag=release-2.3.4 commit=f3d4b88 duration=4m45s status=success
olivia: monitoring — error rate dropping back to baseline, p95 back under 200ms
alex: great. can we pin the deploy to prevent auto-rollforward? I'm pinning the model version in the console
maria: added a note to the release: 'rollback due to decoder latency regression, investigating root cause'
deploy-bot: Release pinned: service=runtime pinned_tag=release-2.3.4 by @alex
maria: we'll open a revert PR to fix the decoder change and re-run canary once fixed
sanjay: can we block the tag release-2.4.0 from future auto-deploys? if not, let's add a block
maria: will add `deploy-block` label in CI and bump the changelog entry to require manual approval
olivia: thanks all, will keep monitoring, marking incident resolved for now :white_check_mark:
alex: filing follow-up ticket ENG-1427 for postmortem
